response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software development maturity with 20+ years of experience and proven architectural and mentoring capabilities, he is fundamentally misaligned with this role. The position requires an experienced C++ systems engineer for industrial automation with security expertise. His C++ background is outdated (last worked with C/C++ in 2014-2015), and his career has drifted toward web/full-stack development. More critically, he lacks essential domain knowledge in industrial automation, secure development lifecycle practices, IEC 62443 standards, and industrial protocols—all core to the role.
strengths: Exceeds experience requirement with 20+ years of software development demonstrating deep seniority, architectural thinking, and ability to design large-scale systems handling millions of requests per second
Strong software craftsmanship fundamentals with proven expertise in TDD, CI/CD, agile methodologies, and quality-first mindset across multiple organizations and complex projects
Demonstrated mentoring and teaching capability through conducting workshops, organizing coding dojos, and contributing to open-source projects, aligning with the team leadership aspects of the role
concerns: C++ expertise significantly outdated (last used in 2014-2015, 11 years ago); career trajectory over the past 5 years has pivoted toward TypeScript, Node.js, and full-stack development rather than systems-level programming required for this role

Lacks demonstrated expertise in Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL), IEC 62443 industrial cybersecurity standards, message brokers, MQTT protocols, and secure coding practices—all listed as core technical competencies

No background in industrial automation, IoT development, embedded systems, or industrial protocols (Modbus TCP/IP, IEC 61850, OPC UA); domain knowledge is misaligned despite these being central to the role's context and responsibilities
